question: What are the ids for all shipments on the planet Mars that Turanga Leela manages?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "employees" AS SELECT "employeeid" AS "employeeid", "name_position" AS "name_position", "salary" AS "salary", "remarks" AS "remarks" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "planets" AS SELECT "planetid" AS "planetid", "name" AS "name", "coordinates" AS "coordinates" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "employee_planet_level" AS SELECT "employee" AS "employee", "planet" AS "planet", "level" AS "level" FROM table_5;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "shipments" AS SELECT "shipment" AS "shipment", "packagenumber" AS "packagenumber", "contents" AS "contents", "weight" AS "weight", "sender" AS "sender", "recipient" AS "recipient" FROM table_6;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
        WITH manager_on_mars AS (
            SELECT epl.employee, epl.planet, epl.level,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY epl.planet ORDER BY epl.level DESC) AS rn
            FROM employee_planet_level epl
            JOIN tmp_emp te ON te.employeeid = epl.employee
            JOIN tmp_mars tm ON tm.planetid = epl.planet
        ),
        is_manager AS (
            SELECT employee, planet FROM manager_on_mars WHERE rn = 1
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT s.shipment AS shipment_id
        FROM shipments s
        JOIN tmp_mars tm ON CAST(s.recipient AS BIGINT) = tm.planetid
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM is_manager m WHERE m.planet = tm.planetid
        )
        ORDER BY shipment_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 2 AS shipment_id
UNION ALL SELECT 3
ORDER BY shipment_id
